request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}. Return one bare JSON object without Markdown fences or commentary. uses_claim must be a JSON boolean. claim_ids must be an array of integer claim numbers, never quoted strings; use an empty array when uses_claim is false.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "**Progress report**", "2": "Two valid interaction features, each with about 98% coverage, found no signal.", "3": "The first failed attempt multiplied the cross-sectional ranks of three-month hourly-pay growth and three-month hours change.", "4": "I expected joint strength to predict outperformance.", "5": "Instead, mean rank correlation was slightly negative, about minus 0.02 with t near minus 1.1.", "6": "It was identical in low and high common-index regimes.", "7": "The second attempt also failed.", "8": "A standardized spread between three-month changes in two flow rates showed essentially zero predictive power (t near 0.05).", "9": "Its sign flipped weakly across regimes.", "10": "Both features had low overlap with base signals (about 0.1) and moderate rank persistence (about 0.35).", "11": "Next I will try stock-rate levels, longer horizons, time-series standardization and explicit regime conditioning."}, "hypothesis": "Hours-rise persistence predicted returns only when the common index was high (IC 0.09 vs -0.04). Conditioning on the high regime should isolate this momentum and raise mean rank correlation and significance.", "expression": "regime(persist(lag(V01,1),6),\"high\")"}
